login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with your nexcrate account.
login.missing: Please enter your username and password.
login.sessionEnded: Your login has expired or was ended. Please log in again.
login.setupClosed: Setup is already done and the account exists. Log in with it.

setup.title: Welcome to nexcrate
setup.intro: Create the account you will use nexcrate with.
setup.languageHint: The language at the top right also becomes the language of your account. You can change it later in the settings.
setup.onlyAccount: Once it exists, nobody can create another one, not even you. A forgotten password can only be reset on the server's command line.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

unreachable.title: nexcrate is not answering right now
unreachable.text: The interface cannot reach the server. Is nexcrate still running? Then try again in a moment.
